description: Focus market expectations survey — annual median/mean forecasts from ~150 economists. Filter by indicator (e.g. "IPCA", "Selic", "PIB Total", "Câmbio", "IGP-M") and optionally reference year. Returns latest survey rows with Media, Mediana, Minimo, Maximo, numeroRespondentes.

indicator.description: Indicador name in Portuguese, e.g. "IPCA", "Selic", "PIB Total", "Câmbio".

reference_year.description: DataReferencia year to filter, e.g. "2026". Optional.

top.description: Max rows to return (default 10, max 100). Ordered by survey Data descending.

name: focus_expectations
title: Focus Expectations
